subject: english
question:
Select the option that can substitute the underlined word segment with the most appropriate idiom.

Denim jackets are __in fashion__ these days.
solution:
The correct answer is **'In vogue'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate idiom to substitute the bracketed word segment "**in fashion**" in the given sentence is "**in vogue**."
 
• "**In vogue**" is an idiom used to describe something that is currently fashionable or popular.
 
• In the context of the sentence, "**Denim jackets are in vogue these days**" means that denim jackets are currently trendy or fashionable.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's a breakdown of the options:
 
• "**In a nut-shell**" means to summarize something briefly. This phrase wouldn't fit the context of the sentence because it doesn't convey the idea of something being fashionable.
 
• "**In lieu of**" means instead of or in place of something else. This phrase doesn't convey the idea of something being fashionable or in trend.
 
• "**In hand**" means having control or possession of something. This phrase doesn't convey the idea of something being fashionable or in trend.
